page.layout: One block of verse in the centre of the page, set in italic lines in stanzas; a catchword-like word "Illi" at the lower right corner of the text block.

p.i:
Fœcundasque simul collibus erigit
Vites pampineis: & grauidas premens
Vuas Sina liquat suaue rubentia,
Syncerisque solet condere in amphoris.

Damnosam refugit desidiem impigra,
Ignauamque procul pellit inertiam:
Nec languere sui robora brachij
Probroso patitur mollior ocio.

Atque experta domum quàm faciles labor
Importet reditus, & fuga inertia,
Accendi tacita noćte iubet faces,
Et cœptum peragit cum famulis opus.

Illi nulla quies: fœmineas manu
Tunc feruente magis prima colos capit,
Et torquet digitis & ssque micantibus
Fusos, & tenui stamine contegit.

Si quos efuries pallida torqueat
Illis prompta cibum porrigit: indigos
Palantesque iuuat, dulcibus & fouet
Tectis, & miseram pauperiem leuat.

Non illam gelidis temporibus niues
Terrent horrifica, nec violentia
Bruma terribilis, vel rigidum gelu,
Vclflatu Boreas Sarmaticus truci.

page.notes: Catchword "Illi" printed at lower right. Several long-s forms and ligatures transcribed as plain s; "ssque" in the fourth-but-one stanza is uncertain (may be "sque" with a misprint) and "Vclflatu" likely "Vel flatu" as printed. Printed ampersand-like sign (Et-sign) rendered as &.
